description: This is a PHP unit test class 'LDAPSyncServiceDeleteUsersTest' that tests the LDAP synchronization service for deleting users who are no longer present on the LDAP server. It verifies the behavior of the LDAPSyncService in various scenarios such as users removed from LDAP, duplicate usernames, and failed LDAP fetches.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceDeleteUsersTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing LDAP synchronization user deletion functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the fixture directory path before each test.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Tests the deletion of local users who are no longer present in LDAP server, verifying that the correct users are marked as deleted.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Tests user deletion logic with LDAP entries having duplicate usernames, ensuring only appropriate users are marked deleted.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServerWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Tests deletion behavior when some LDAP entries fail to fetch, verifying that only valid LDAP users are considered for deletion.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Mocks and constructs an EntryCollection object from LDAP entries and lookup setting.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Creates mock LDAP Entry objects for provided username list.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithDuplicateUserNames
methods.description: Creates mock LDAP Entry objects with duplicate usernames for testing deduplication logic.

methods.name: getLDAPEntriesWithFailedUsers
methods.description: Creates LDAP Entry objects with missing required attributes to simulate LDAP fetch failure scenarios.
